HANDS ONLY move with micro finger curl adjustments. Camera itself NEVER moves. Returns to neutral idle after speech ends. [MIDGROUND_RIGHT] A tall male diabolical doctor in a weathered black medical coat with old brass buttons, a pale undershirt, and rough textured gloves. His face is ashen and severe, with sharp pale eyes and a rigid mouth. He stands upright and faces forward.. FACING CAMERA. NOT moving toward camera. ABSOLUTE FIXED POSITION. Root locked to floor.
